import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aStr = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aStr[i]);
        }

        int half = n / 2;
        List<Integer> part1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> part2 = new ArrayList<>();

        generateSums1(0, 0, a, m, half, part1);
        generateSums2(half, 0, a, m, n, part2);

        Collections.sort(part1);
        int maxSum = 0;

        for (int val : part2) {
            int target = m - val;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(part1, target);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 1;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                int candidate = part1.get(idx - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > maxSum) {
                    maxSum = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxSum);
    }

    private static void generateSums1(int index, int total, int[] a, int m, int half, List<Integer> part1) {
        if (index == half) {
            part1.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSums1(index + 1, (total + a[index]) % m, a, m, half, part1);
            generateSums1(index + 1, total, a, m, half, part1);
        }
    }

    private static void generateSums2(int index, int total, int[] a, int m, int n, List<Integer> part2) {
        if (index == n) {
            part2.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSums2(index + 1, (total + a[index]) % m, a, m, n, part2);
            generateSums2(index + 1, total, a, m, n, part2);
        }
    }
}
